caption: A row of upright wooden dominoes falls in sequence after the first domino is pushed.

clauses.text: The first domino must be pushed to initiate the chain reaction.
Each domino must be positioned upright and close enough to topple the next one in sequence.
The surface must remain stable and flat to ensure consistent domino falls.
The push must be applied with sufficient force to start the sequence without disturbing the alignment of subsequent dominoes.
